notes: Custom matches now play two rounds with an automatic side swap: after round 1 the sides switch and round 2 starts on the same map without going back to the lobby, then everyone sees the ranked result pages (winner, points, ranking). The host can switch it off in the lobby with the new Team Swap row under Spawn Protection. Also new: a freeze recorder that writes System\HitchCatch.log when the game freezes for a quarter of a second, so the log bundle shows what blocked it. Everything from x64 stays.

addons.title: Two rounds with a side swap
